Mission Local reported that three young men arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to wait for “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom,” bringing folding chairs, snacks and work essentials. About 10 more gamers joined them over the next three hours. The first three got the store’s first collector’s-edition slots; the story also described the wait as a “dying tradition” as more people buy games digitally.
